verdicts.why: In Born Again S2#3 Daredevil infiltrates the AVTF base at Red Hook and frees the detainees, Soledad Ayala among them.
In Daredevil S2#8 Stick rescues Matt and Elektra from Hand ninjas, treats Elektra at Matt's apartment and reveals she has long worked for him; he had sent her to recruit Matt in college.
In The Defenders#6 Elektra stabs Stick to death while Matt begs her not to kill him.
Theo appears in S3#2, 5, 9, 11 and 13, always with Foggy; his only time with Matt is the S3#13 family gathering at Nelson's Meats. Nothing on screen makes him an old friend of Matt's.
In Daredevil S2#13 the Hand holds Turk hostage and starts sawing off his foot to remove his ankle tracker, and Daredevil arrives and saves him and the other hostages.
In Daredevil S1#9 Matt visits the Scene Contempo Gallery, Vanessa shows him around, then introduces him to Fisk. This is their first meeting, well before Born Again.
In Daredevil S3#13 Daredevil stops Dex's attacks on Vanessa at the wedding, then makes Fisk go back to prison by threatening to prove her part in Nadeem's death.

In Daredevil S1#5 Vladimir finds the mask on Anatoly's body and blames the masked man. After the bombing the masked man ambushes him, Vladimir fires and misses every shot, and he is beaten until the police arrive. They are enemies before the S1#6 alliance.

In Daredevil S3#7 Melvin reveals that he burned his workshop rather than help Fisk, but Fisk had a new one built and threatened Betsy. Melvin made Dex's Daredevil suit and a second suit to frame Daredevil.

In Daredevil S1#9 Fisk goads Nobu into fighting the masked man himself, later admits that 'in a perfect world' the two would kill each other, and tells Wesley to let Nobu burn. That is a betrayal, so the kind turns there.
Sonia takes Vido and Oscar gets him back at the bus station in Jessica Jones S2#9. In S2#4 Sonia only argues with Oscar.
In Luke Cage S2#10, after Nandi Tyler is exposed, Ridley tells Misty the precinct will need a new commander and that it should be her.
Extra ruling: an LMD version is not the person, so there is no stage for May and the Chronicom LMD Coulson in S7. The real Coulson is dead by then.

In Born Again S2#3 Powell orders the AVTF to fire on all the prisoners Daredevil frees, and Jack is one of them. That is a shared battle, and in S2#4 Powell only hunts him by name. Nothing passes between the two.
In Born Again S2#4 Powell leads the AVTF raid on Murdock & McDuffie, saying Safer Streets means he needs no warrant. He asks Kirsten where Duquesne is, and she deflects the questions.
In Born Again S1#6 Fisk recruits Powell into the AVTF, but nothing happens between Powell and Matt in that title. The stage describes no interaction.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#8
value.text: After Matt reveals in court that he is Daredevil, Powell signals a sniper to shoot him in the courthouse lobby, but the real Bullseye fires at Fisk instead. Both end up in prison at Rikers.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hector's lawyer, revealed as Daredevil. Powell orders him shot at the courthouse.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Arrests Matt's client Hector and jumps Matt. Later orders him shot at the courthouse.

verdicts.why: After Matt reveals he is Daredevil in S2#8, Powell signals the sniper to shoot him while Fisk confronts him in the courthouse lobby, so 'outside the courthouse' is wrong. Both later end up at Rikers.

Ridenhour replacing Ridley is stated in S2#1, so stage 1 repeats stage 0. In S2#9 Ridley returns to the precinct after his murder and tells Misty she learned a lot of lessons from Tommy Ridenhour over the years.

value.title: Daredevil S3#1
value.text: FBI agent Ray Nadeem meets Fisk in prison, and Fisk asks him for a deal.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A jailed crime boss who asks Nadeem for a deal.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The FBI agent Fisk asks for a deal from prison.

verdicts.why: They meet in Daredevil S3#1, where Fisk tells Nadeem at Rikers that he wants a deal. The Albanian takedown comes in S3#2. The added stage has to start where they meet, so its text should stay with S3#1.
In Daredevil S3#13 Hattley publicly blames Nadeem for Winn's death. His dying declaration, made public that day, names her as responsible for it, and after the arrests she corroborates it.
In Daredevil S3#13, once Fisk is arrested and can no longer hurt her daughter, Hattley corroborates Nadeem's dying declaration against him. That is a clear turn on Fisk.
Scythe is one man, Gao's third challenger in Iron Fist S1#6, so the plural card lines copied from the Veznikov pair are false.
In Luke Cage S1#8, after Cottonmouth's death, Shades tells Zip 'Y'all work for me now' and hands him cash for new clothes. Zip accepts him as his new boss.
Trish takes Simpson's combat pills in Jessica Jones S1#11. In S1#10 he only attacks Albert and Trish and is locked out, so a stage that says she takes his pills cannot start at #10.
In Jessica Jones S2#2 Trish shoots the man trailing her in the leg and ties him up. He explains he has been protecting her, then dies holding off the attacker so Jessica and Trish can run.

Turk and Fisk are never on screen together. James Wesley pays Turk in S1#5, and Turk only talks about Fisk, so the stage line 'Fisk pays him' is also false. Turk knows of Fisk but Fisk does not know him.
Hernandez only learns about Rawlins, names him to Marion James, and sees his body bagged in The Punisher S1#13. They never meet alive, and Hernandez's part has no huge consequences for Rawlins.
In the Battle of Earth, Tony glances at Strange, who signals that this is the one outcome where they win. Tony then takes the Stones and dies.
In Thunderbolts* Taskmaster kicks U.S. Agent away from Yelena and tells her she is not there for her. Ghost later shoots Taskmaster dead in the vault.
T'Chaka dies in Captain America: Civil War, before Toussaint is born. They never meet, and a blood tie never met is not a connection.

value.title: Daredevil S3#1
value.text: Sister Maggie, a nun who helped raise Matt at the orphanage, nurses him back to health after he is found near death and counsels him as he recovers.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The man she helped raise at the orphanage, nursed back to health in her care.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A nun who helped raise Matt, and nurses him back to health.

verdicts.why: The rule says a connection that clearly starts in an earlier title gets a stage there. From Daredevil S3#1 Maggie nurses Matt and counsels him through S3#8, warning him not to become the monster and urging him to reach out to his friends. That guiding role fits mentor until the S3#9 family reveal.

In Thor: Love and Thunder Valkyrie fights Gorr beside Thor at New Asgard and goes with him to Omnipotence City and the Shadow Realm. She steals Zeus's thunderbolt as they escape, and Gorr injures her.
In VisionQuest#4 Vision yields control to Ultron because he cannot beat Jocasta. Ultron tricks Jocasta, not Vision, then traps Vision and the AIs in the Mindspace and leaves with Tommy.

Valentina and Thaddeus Ross are never seen together. She is only in Black Widow's credits scene and is not in Captain America: Brave New World, and in Thunderbolts* she only mentions his rampage without naming him.

Miriam first appears, in a flashback only, in Spider-Man (1994) S2E9 (#22, 'Blade, the Vampire Hunter'), where she leaves Eric at a New Orleans orphanage after his vampire father abandons them. Real flashbacks count.
Mysterio joins the Master Planner's re-formed Sinister Six in S2E3 'Reinforcement' (#16). The S2E4 (#17) cast does not list him.
In 'Survival of the Fittest' (#1) Toomes berates his old colleague Otto at Oscorp over Tech Flight, and as he is thrown out he says he no longer blames him. Stage 0 at #11 wrongly puts this there.
In 'Group Therapy' (#11) Otto, in prison at Ryker's, has Toomes gather the other villains and they break out as the Sinister Six. The Oscorp scene belongs to #1.
